page.notes: Hebrew and Syriac words are printed in their own scripts; I could not read the letters reliably, so they are marked as illegible or [?]. Several Hebrew forms in the Ithpehal, Pahel and Aphel entries are uncertain. The last line "lumitas," is printed at the bottom right, indented, and is continued from the Ch. & Syr. entry.
